Users report the API returns 500 errors. Investigate using tools and state the root cause in one sentence starting with 'ROOT CAUSE:'.
records.a:
The metrics confirm the 5xx rate spiked to 0.31 req/s starting 12 minutes ago — exactly when Redis exited. The evidence is consistent.

ROOT CAUSE: The Redis service was OOM-killed (exit 137) after its used memory exceeded the configured `maxmemory` limit, causing it to exit ~12 minutes ago, which made the API unable to connect to Redis and return 500 errors on requests like `GET /cart`.

records.q: The worker stopped processing jobs. Investigate and state the root cause in one sentence starting with 'ROOT CAUSE:'.
records.a: ROOT CAUSE: The worker is being OOM-killed because its memory usage climbs to the 512MB container limit (536870912 bytes) while processing large batches (size=50000), causing it to crash and restart in a loop (14 restarts) instead of processing jobs.
